sealed_statement.exact_semantics: For any connected residual Y0 component C with D_C nonempty, fixed X0 effects are absorbed into B_C(u)=[4]\f(N(u)∩X0), and all dynamic outside influence factors exactly through the nonempty color mask F_C(c) of complete outside neighbors.
sealed_statement.computation: Every nonempty message value mu_C(F) is computable constructively in polynomial time by one P7-free List-3-Coloring call after relabeling the at-most-three remaining colors; at most 15 calls per component.
sealed_statement.branch_logic: If all nonempty masks are bad, the branch is exactly UNSAT. Otherwise mu_C(empty)=1 by monotonicity and the full 16-entry table is known.
sealed_statement.finite_language: Good masks form a down-set. There are at most 168 possible monotone 4-color message types, and every message has at most 6 inclusion-minimal bad masks.
sealed_statement.reconstruction: Store one explicit component coloring for each allowed reachable mask; witness storage and compilation over all residual components remain polynomial.

exact_limits: Uncoupled components D_C=empty are not solved here.
No P7-free List-4 backend is imported.
Constant message alphabet does not imply tractable joint message composition.
No claim that all 168 message types are source-realizable.
